title: Canonical constant scalars commute with scheme coefficient maps
statement: For any commutative topological ring A in Type u, every scheme morphism j:U->T, and every pro-etale test object V over T, the canonical constant scalar map from [lem-sf-finite-discrete-normalized-encoding] followed by condensedPushforwardHom (coefficient A) j equals the same canonical constant scalar map on the base-changed test object over U. This requires neither finite or discrete A nor nonempty schemes.

proof.text: Reuse the general constantScheme_pushforward terminal-unit proof from the terminal-comparison module for the canonical pointConstants adjoint. Propagate along the unique map from a test object to the base-changed terminal object using naturality.

proof_origin.note: A proved specialization of the existing general terminal-unit proof, followed by naturality; it removes the public Type-0 coefficient restriction from the scalar compatibility interface.

theorem canonicalAbelianMap_naturality (T U : Scheme.{u}) (j : U ⟶ T) (V : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) :
    (toSheafify (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
        ((Functor.const T.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} A))) ≫
      (canonicalAbelianMap A T).hom).app V ≫
        (condensedPushforwardHom (coefficient A) j).hom.app V =
    (toSheafify (Scheme.ProEt.topology U)
        ((Functor.const U.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} A))) ≫
      (canonicalAbelianMap A U).hom).app
        ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @WeaklyEtale ⊤ j).op.obj V)
